q1_issues.issue: (Member addr_54346_avenida_velasco address) invents a type atom — the word 'address' occurs nowhere in the text, and a type atom is licensed only when the kind is readable off the words.

The definitional decomposition atoms (Inheritance phone_call call) and (Inheritance domestic_disturbance disturbance) are kept inside the sealed Theme, but the projection table sends compound-kind decomposition atoms out of an attitude seal to top level.
The temporal 'when' clause is left unlinked: the begin event and the receive event are both sealed as plain past events with no During/Before between them, so the stated co-timing is unencoded.

The second, separate bare-plural 'deputies' reuses the matrix group witness sk_group_1, which asserts that the deputies who spoke are the same ones who received the call — an indefinite mention would ordinarily mint a fresh group.

q2_gaps: what type atom, if any, a numeral-initial street-address name takes — the rule fixes the symbol (addr_ prefix) and the verbatim Name string but says nothing about its kind, and the 'kind word inside the name' licence assumes an English common noun, not 'Avenida'
notes: Sealing of the zero-complementizer report, surface-mechanical past inside the seal, the tenseless reduced relatives ('requesting', 'regarding' as an event rather than a coined head), and the definite 'the incident' projecting its typing are all handled per the instruction set.
